title: X15: Five processes each stand up their own NSPersistentCloudKitContainer with mirroring active on one shared store file

description: The widget process operates under a ~30MB memory budget the engineering notes already flag as unaffordable for this. Severity: Medium. Wave/Plan: Wave 1, plan 1c store-location-unification. Sweep: cross-process. Fix: only apps arm mirroring - widget/extensions/CLI open without cloudKitContainerOptions.
